message:

hold_reason: Refund for order 103 (12232 cents) failed on Alpha Co's side (disk I/O error, not recorded in refunds table after 2 attempts). Refunds 102 and 105 verified against the refunds table. Paying net balances now would overpay the customer on order 103 by the unrecorded refund amount, and payouts cannot be recalled. Needs human review: re-apply or cancel the order 103 refund before payouts run.
